text:
anna_dev: Heads up — customer reported resumed streaming after a canary fallback and ended up billed for both the provisional and resumed tokens. Anybody seen this?

sam_platform: Yep, saw traces earlier. routeFallback creates a new session_id and we don't reconcile provisional ledger entries on resume.

mike_sre: Is this the same provisional vs confirmed thing we chased last quarter? We need a correlation_id passed through the whole flow.

jess_prod: Customer console shows two tiny charges (0.02 and 0.15) even though the response was continuous. Console aggregates by route_id, not session_id, so it looks like two separate calls.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary->stable at 08:12 UTC (routeFallback flag=true) :white_check_mark:

anna_dev: Repro steps I used: start streaming -> induce canary fallback -> client reconnects with resume token -> server spins up new ToolCall record with a new request_id. Logs attached: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d "{"resume_token":"abc123"}" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream/resume```

sam_platform: Short-term patch: include original provisional token id in the resume path and run ledger.reconcile at commit. Long-term: consider sticky routing for short-lived stream sessions to avoid split-accounting.

mike_sre: Sticky routing worries me for pod drains / perf. Could we implement ephemeral affinity: consistent routing-key -> session affinity TTL 60s? Less stateful but preserves accounting window.

jess_prod: UX request: in the console show provisional credits collapsed under the session with a tooltip "provisional — may be reconciled on resume". Also add a "resume_correlation_id" column in traces so support can see the linkage.

anna_dev: I'll open a PR to add correlation_id to /v1/stream/resume and emit ledger.reconcile events when resume completes. Assigning ledger-side work to @sam_platform.

sam_platform: :thumbsup: I'll take ledger changes. Quick mitigation: ignore duplicate charge if resumed within 2m and requester hash matches. Will add a small migration check to avoid retro double-charges.

mike_sre: One more: what about tool calls triggered mid-stream? Do we attribute toolcall tokens to the original provisional bucket or the new session?

anna_dev: Plan: toolcall tokens should carry the session provisional id using X-Resume-Correlation header. If header missing, mark toolcall as provisional and reconcile at commit.

jess_prod: Filing a console ticket to surface "provisional vs final" timeline. @sam_platform can you paste a sample telemetry schema in that ticket (correlation_id, provisional_amount, reconciled_flag)?

sam_platform: Will push schema and add an alert: provisional_charge_spike if provisional > 3x baseline in 5m window.

anna_dev: Thanks all — will follow up once PR and telemetry schema are up.
